purpose: pre-specified internal component attribution for PC-NFPSO

common_rules.sc_radius: use single globally selected development-only radius; no ablation-specific retuning
common_rules.ridge_alpha: use single globally selected development-only ridge alpha; no ablation-specific retuning
common_rules.initialization: same subtractive-clustering particle-0 initialization and same random initialization rule

boundary_projection.name: project
boundary_projection.rule: reflect velocity components associated with out-of-bounds coordinates, then coordinate-wise clip candidate to the frozen feasible box

boundary_no_projection.name: feasible_rejection
boundary_no_projection.rule: if any coordinate of a proposed particle move is outside the frozen feasible box, reject that proposed move, retain the previous particle position, and reverse the offending velocity components; do not evaluate an infeasible model

NF_BASE.antecedents: subtractive-clustering initialization using frozen global radius
NF_BASE.final_refit: consequents refit on complete pre-test training segment
NF_BASE.role: isolates total value of antecedent PSO optimization

synthetic_final_ablation.processes: all nine frozen synthetic process families
synthetic_final_ablation.optimizer_aggregation: median within process x DGP-seed x noise
synthetic_final_ablation.noise_aggregation: arithmetic mean across the three confirmatory noise levels

real_final_ablation.purpose: external-domain anchor for whether antecedent PSO optimization improves over the clustering-only neuro-fuzzy model

planned_component_contrasts.projection_constriction_interaction: compare the two projection effects and the two constriction effects descriptively

inferential_family.confidence_interval: 95 percent exact nonparametric order-statistic CI for median paired difference
inferential_family.multiplicity: Holm correction across the seven pre-specified synthetic ablation reference contrasts

interpretation_rules.interaction_claim: descriptive unless separately supported; do not claim interaction significance from unmatched pairwise p-values
interpretation_rules.feature_ablation: not included because engineered features are not part of the frozen base PC-NFPSO definition
interpretation_rules.ridge_zero_ablation: not included; ridge is treated as a frozen estimation component rather than a claimed novelty
